title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I should probably have these transitions before the chorus occur at a better tempo...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Alright, if I rearrange these cuts and throw in some wipes, they should look pretty different from before.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! The first draft of my storyboard's all finished! Looks pretty good, if I do say so myself♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Using Ena's rough draft to put together a storyboard was definitely the right way to go! I should be able to make this video as dynamic as the song like I hoped.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd like to hear what the others think, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (After her mom took away her synthesizer, she had to take a break from arranging music and start focusing more on just writing lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she's been logging off so early recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, Mafuyu stayed with us the entire time when we all went to PXL, so I guess she feels bad about disappointing her mom...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As worried as I am, I can't really just ask her about...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line:
<K, are you there...?
I've finished writing the lyrics, so I'll send them over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, she's still here. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that was fast.
How did it go?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh. You'll have to see to find out! I just sent it...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want to clean it up and make it better, so I'm open to all suggestions!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I like it...
You've brought this song's theme to life while throwing in some nice personal touches, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Really? Thanks!
I'm glad I put in the effort!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, credit where credit's due, the visual imagery in Enanan's rough draft was really amazing and made my job a lot easier...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, can we go with something else for the chorus?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, it'd delay when we upload the song...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But if we're gonna go with this structure, I want the part before the chorus to pack a bigger punch!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A bigger punch...? Hmm... I thought spins and wipes on one image would work here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <However, Enanan, you might be right. It might be easier to get K and Yuki's message across by going with your idea. So, what do you two think...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I agree.
Yes, I'd like to upload this song as soon as possible...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if you two believe that it can be made better, then I'd like for us to make those changes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll work on my rough draft... What?! It's already half past four?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, it's been a while since you last stayed on this late...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you're right.
Are you sure you don't need to go to bed?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I don't have cram school tomorrow, so I don't need to get up early.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see.
But please don't push yourself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <However... I'll have my hands full with cram school starting next week, so I want to do as much as I can right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Also, I have another practice exam coming up soon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um, Yuki...?
How have things between you and your mom been recently?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<The same as usual...
She's very concerned about my well-being.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The night of that practice exam, after I told her that I couldn't take it because I wasn't feeling well, she asked that I refrain from staying up so late to study.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why you've been logging off early recently.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm only here now because my mom went to bed early.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Outside of that, there's nothing that comes to mind...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you need to tell us the next time something does happen...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, it was really fun to go somewhere and hang out together!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. It even helped me come up with song ideas, so I think it was worth the trip.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Okay, to be fair, I wasn't sure what was gonna happen after a certain someone showed up looking sick to her stomach... But it turned out to be really fun, so I hope we get to go again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
Then, the next time we go, we should pick a day when Yuki isn't...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The hallway... I thought I just heard a noise...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She took away your synthesizer already, so if she finds out that you're still doing music-related stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going to go take a look...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I didn't see anybody...
It may've just been my imagination...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yuki, if you're concerned...
It's okay to reduce the amount of time you spend on here.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Especially since we don't know what's going to happen if your mom finds out... That's on top of studying, so I'd rather not see you forced into a corner.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I feel the most at ease when I'm working here...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems to be most at ease whenever she's creating music with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
But please take a break when you feel the need.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um...
Isn't that the first time Yuki herself said, “I feel the most at ease when I'm working here”...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You're right.
Her saying such a thing may be an ominous sign considering what's been going on with her...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But at the same time, I'm kind of glad that she did...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess it's now safe to say that we're providing a space where Mafuyu feels comfortable...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, we should probably get back to work soon... Amia, can we have a quick chat about that part before the chorus?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... I'll be logging off temporarily to take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. See you in a bit, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, let's run with that!
If you'll take what we just discussed and make those changes to the storyboard...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sure thing! And you'd be doing me a huge favor if you could start working on the illustrations for the non-chorus parts!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No problem.
Also, something crossed my mind just now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This storyboard... It looks a lot like the first one you did, doesn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This song sorta had the same theme as that one, so I decided to do a little self-homage! But I didn't think anyone would notice since it was so subtle...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, how long have we known each other now? Lately, I feel like I've been getting a more intuitive sense of what you want to express.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We have known each other for pretty long, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Back then...
I never saw myself being with anyone for very long.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I feel the most at ease when I'm working here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Uh, no!
It's just... I'm happy to hear that you actually pay close attention to the videos I make, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? What's that supposed to mean? I always pay close attention.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And that makes me really happy!
So, Enanan, thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, okay. You're welcome...
Anyway, let's get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I must've fallen asleep while talking to Ena yesterday... Argh, my body... I'm aching all over...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What time is it...? Where'd I put my phone...? Oh, Mom sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: <Morning, Mizuki! I'm going to work now! I made some seafood curry for lunch, so please make sure to have some!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seafood curry?! Sweet!
You're the best, Mom♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
<Oh, your sister sent you a package.
I'll leave it down in the living room.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(This package is huge!
What on earth did Sis send me?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, she must've made these!
Wow... It's cool to see that she can make stuff like this now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can tell that this young designer making a name for herself abroad has the right stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? There's something else really deep down... What is this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? A greeting card...? Let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Greeting Card
rows.Line: <To Mizuki, the cutest person in the world>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Sis. “Cutest” might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But since she sent this to me, I think I'll try it on♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, she's right... I do definitely look cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But this ribbon and all these clothes... It's like she's written her signature on all of them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's great to see that Sis is having fun over there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, she even sent snacks!
These are just as cute and colorful...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, come to think of it...
Miku and the others might really like it if I shared some of this candy with them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll take some of these over to them! They'll probably love it too since they came from overseas♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see. Where are Miku and the...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
Look over there♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess you can't help but look the same way I point my finger, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha... Luka's such a meanie.
Hey, over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I was sent some snacks you don't see very often and decided to share them with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Snacks...
Rin and Len might like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki, that ribbon looks lovely on you. Is it new? Did you just buy it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this came with the snacks.
My big sis sent it to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a big sister who's much older than me. She's still just starting out, but she's a fashion designer.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's living abroad right now and has it kinda tough right now... But she's working really hard towards achieving her dream of owning her own business.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Her own business overseas...?
That's very ambitious of her. Has she been living abroad long?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I'd say pretty long... She moved right around the time I joined N25.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kanade and Mafuyu told us a story about how N25 initially came to be, but we didn't get to hear about when you and Ena joined, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
The timing felt a bit off to get into that, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you mind telling us about that?
I'm sure Miku's already bored of playing rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm not bored, but...
I'd also like to hear more about that, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you do?
I mean, it's really not that interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
I can't really say no to these faces, can I?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright... I'll try going in order, starting with around the time I was in my last year of junior high.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really had a lot on my mind back then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That was when I heard one of Kanade's songs and decided that I wanted to start making music videos.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You had a lot on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... We're talking about A LOT...

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“Ahem. Good morning, everyone.
The cherry blossoms lined up near our school are all in full bloom, and it gives me great pleasure to welcome in a new school year.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's always such a pain to have to start again in a completely new class. So is dealing with the first years.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that the person they were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe. The description my big brother gave me seems pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ugh... I would've been able to ditch if the teachers hadn't found me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I can just head up to the rooftop after this. Rui's also probably pretty bored and...)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“That concludes this speech.
Everyone, let's all do our best to make the most of this school year.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, let's try talking to that person!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place really is nice and quiet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I just thought up a wonderful idea for an effect. Would you like to hear?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't mind a little noise...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (However, before Rui started coming up here, this was normal...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And another dull year that I have to survive...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's not like there's anything I can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, MiraMagi's on today!
I have to watch it as it airs!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The final episode's also coming up... Man, I really don't want to see this show end.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Despite it being an evening children's anime, it has such a good story. Not only that, the characters are cute and people always write great comments about this show on forums...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And above all else, the protagonist's enemy and rival, Mia, is just too adorable!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe... I can't wait to see what the finale's like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also. I heard that they're gonna do some promos and stuff to get everyone excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, here we go...!
The “Let's Root For MiraMagi Together” promotional campaign!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, we're allowed to make videos for this. I might just have to take a crack at it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, lemme just turn on my PC...
And I can give that effect plugin I bought the other day a try.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I started doing this to kill time when I'm bored, but I'm really glad that I started making my own videos...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get to choose whatever music, assets, effects and everything else I like while also being able to edit it however I please. Not only that, it lets me focus in a way that I can block out all unnecessary distractions.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Before I entered junior high, I made my own clothes and accessories...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, how should I do this...?
I could try creating a montage of all the best scenes up to this point...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, are you making a MiaMagic video?
You really do love that show, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis, it's not “MiaMagic”. It's called “MiraMagi”! Or “Miracle Magic Girl ☆ Lala”! The animated epic about Lala, the magical girl who's fighting to save the day, that's all the rage right now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While Mia's the girl who's her enemy and rival, so please don't get them mixed up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Ah, right. Yes.
Haha. I'm sorry, Mizuki. I must've gotten them mixed up since you seem to really enjoy talking about Mia.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be fair, it is kinda confusing...
Anyway, did you need something from me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, I was just packing up my things and found all these clothes that I'd made in the past. Would you like them, Mizuki? They're all in this box.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, you used to make this kind of stuff...?! You really are an amazing designer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Although, my fashion school teachers didn't really like this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the ones at that school in France called you a genius, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: A genius...? I really don't think I was called that, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Over here, my teachers would say that my designs were “far too radical” without even really looking at what I'd drawn. I was even turned away by so many others when it came time to look for a job...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which is why I was so happy when I discovered peers who believed the opposite of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know you went through a lot and had to work really hard... But I'm also happy that they acknowledged your talents!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Sis, good luck over there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? I'm not leaving until next month.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
...
By the way... How have you been recently...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, school can be a real drag sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I get to watch my favorite anime and make videos about it, so I'd say I'm in a good place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Remember, I'm always here to listen if something does end up bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Especially since we won't get many chances to chat like this in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis!
But I'm okay. There's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm just gonna do what I can to enjoy the present!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, you two, I bought some cake. Would you like to have some?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, cake? Yes, please!
Let's go, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, did you do that assignment that's due today? I completely forgot and don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, you forgot too?
Actually, so did I... You think anyone will let us copy their answers...?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hehe. Akiyama gets pretty good grades, right? Wanna see if we can copy what they wrote?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, Akiyama...?
Do you know what you're saying?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Honestly, I don't really care at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Fourth period should be over soon, right...? Oh, there's still thirty minutes to go...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So much time...
I just wanna go home and work on my videos...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which scenes would work for this video...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Man, the story's just so good...
This episode was when I totally fell in love with Mia too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though she was her enemy for the longest time, Mia dove in to save the protagonist, Lala, when it seemed like she was done for.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She has to defeat Lala because the big bad boss is holding her little sister hostage, and I was so moved by how she couldn't get herself to do that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I went from rooting for her when she was doing her best despite struggling to becoming a wholehearted fan.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Then, I began scouring social media for info about Mia... My account name, Amia, is even based on her name. But I'm not sure I want people knowing that now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the final episode airs next week...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As much as I want to see how it ends, I don't want it to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My teacher finally scolded me for not attending more regularly...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Seriously, who cares? I do just fine on tests without actually going to class, so what's wrong with me ditching every so often?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess they'll tell me that school isn't just about studying...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They'll say, “You have to make an effort to get along with everyone.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just wanna work on my videos...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today, I might try using a glitch effect to tie some scenes together. I bet it'll make the battle between Mia and Lala look so cool...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why can't school just end already...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's done...!
Whew... Thank goodness I made it in time for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And it's...uploaded.
Hehe. I hope everyone likes it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thirty minutes until the finale airs...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, should I watch while keeping an eye on the forums...? But I kinda want to just watch it since it's the last episode...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, I should go grab some snacks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's showtime!
Hehe. I can't wait to see how it all ends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I have no idea how they're gonna defeat the Demon Lord. I mean, all the Miracle Orbs that they gathered were destroyed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what if they performed a new level of transformation and joined forces...?! That'd be so cool! Especially if it means getting to see Mia in a new outfit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, that makes sense. They don't stand a chance at this rate, and they've done everything they possibly can...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The music and effects are perfect too.
It totally screams, “We're doomed!”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! You can do it, Mia!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, that was such an awesome finale! I never would've seen that coming!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's more, Mia kicked some serious butt!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What am I gonna watch next...?
This other anime's supposed to take MiraMagi's time slot, but I'm not really feeling it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see what else is airing this summer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, there's a ton of new shows.
Oh, the character designs for this one are super cute. But the story seems kinda dull...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... MiraMagi just hit me so hard...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I shouldn't be feeling so down. Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Sis said she wanted to hear what I thought of the finale, so I can go tell her all about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, out shopping...?
Right, she needs plug adapters to match whatever they have overseas. Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What is this?
It feels so real now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not too long from now, she's gonna be gone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And we won't be able to talk like we usually do because of the time difference.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (About what's fun or what's bothering us...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though MiraMagi ended and Sis is going away... As long as I find something fun to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Can I...?
Am I ever actually going to...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Watching anime, making videos, playing video games and reading manga were all really fun things to do.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why is that...? I don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, let's try talking to that person!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, Akiyama...?
Do you know what you're saying?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Mizuki, I'm going to work now!
Make sure to eat lunch, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize!
Your father even said that you don't have to go to school if you really don't want to, so there's nothing to worry about. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I appreciate what Mom said, but I'm sure she's really worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line:
No, it's me.
Mind if I come in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, sure... But my room's a mess...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm coming in...
Haha. Your room's much cleaner than mine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki, take a look at this photo.
I found it while sorting through my things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Do you remember when we took this?
We wore matching ribbons, and you just looked absolutely adorable, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, how about we have lunch together?
Mom made some French fries for us today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm really not that hungry right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay...
But just ask me whenever and I'll heat them back up for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And let me know if you need anything else...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Geez, she's probably worried sick about me now too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't want her to worry, and I know I should go to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm so tired of everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'm almost done going through everyone's comments online about the MiraMagi finale...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really won't have anything else to do after that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
If only I could just disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's with this video? Why's its thumbnail all black...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on its description... It's a song...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This feels like something out of a horror movie... But I guess I'll give it a listen since it's not like I have anything else to do.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Whoa, this song...
What is this feeling..?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Listening to it... I can sense all this pain... But there's also kindness there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's making my chest tighten up, but it also feels kinda nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, there's that mix of pain and kindness again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like this song's written about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who wrote this? Have they made anything else? Oh, here's their account...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, they've produced a ton of songs... And all the thumbnails are pitch-black. Not many people do that nowadays...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I'll give some of their other songs a listen...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like each song deals with a different kind of pain... It's so clear just by listening to them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, there's always something waiting at the end... A ray of light that barely shines through...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't believe there's someone making music like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously, who is this person?
Their account name's...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (K...? Is that a person's name or the name of a group...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That didn't work...
Just “K” is way too short. I'm not getting any good search results.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Some people left comments, but they're all just saying, “K's so amazing,” and, “What do you think K's like?”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I decided to listen to their music on a whim. It's not like I really want to find out who...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hang on... This illustration on PicShare... Is it fan art?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(“Based on music by K”...
Yeah, it has to be.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A girl's crying as she sits beneath the moonlit sky. Based on her expression, she must've gotten lost in this forest and doesn't know where to go...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This illustration... It goes so well with that first song I heard.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They should have this as the thumbnail for that song instead of just a black rectangle.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And if it were up to me, I'd use it to make a video that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A video that begins with the moon from this illustration coming into focus... And it'd have this sort of retro color scheme to it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It wouldn't be easy, but if I were to break it into parts, I might be able to animate it... Also...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I could throw in a few other effects...
Just a few...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is so awesome, if I do say so myself...! And I stayed faithful to the song's theme from start to finish...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I totally captured that strange mix of pain and kindness! Plus...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, no...!
I shouldn't be using someone else's art without asking them first!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Using art without asking first... I get that some people get carried away and do it without thinking, but I still hate when people do that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can enjoy it for myself since I haven't uploaded it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But since I went through the trouble of actually making it, I kinda want to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I could just send the artist a message with the expectation in mind that they'll turn me down...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Enanan...
That's pretty cute... I never would've guessed based on their art.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(How should I start my DM?
I guess I should introduce myself, so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that was the first music video I'd ever made...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So you discovered the music Kanade and Mafuyu had made, as well as Ena's art, during a time when you didn't want to go to school?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why didn't you want to go to school, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why...? Well, a lot of reasons...
Most of all, it just felt like such a drag...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And what happened after you sent Ena that message...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Fancy seeing you here at this time.
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got up at a normal time and felt pretty refreshed, so I decided to work on my illustration.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I think I went a bit overboard. After a while, my body started feeling really tense, so I came over to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. As for us, you arrived right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right on cue? Were you talking about me just now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Well, to be fair, it wasn't about you specifically, but the time when we decided to join N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We were just at the part when I made a music video using your art without asking for your permission.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember...!
I was totally floored by that message you sent me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, imagine being asked, “I apologize if this is sudden, but I made a music video using your art. I'd like to ask you for permission to upload it online,” completely out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And how did you feel after receiving that message, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Me?
Surprised, to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Back then, art was sort of ruling my life.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ruling your life...?
Were you also going through a tough period?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, kinda...
You could say that I was at my wit's end...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear more about what things were like back then for you, Ena. Along with how you discovered Kanade's music.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I don't know much about what happened before we started working together either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, you don't have to tell us if you don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-It's not that don't want to...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, who am I kidding...?
What's the point of trying to hide anything at this point?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure. It's not exactly a happy story, so try not to be disappointed, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Where should I start...? Maybe just before the time I entered high school...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
High school...?
Don't you and Mizuki attend the same one?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I take classes at night.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And a lot happened before I ended up enrolling there. Simply put...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I couldn't get into the art school that I desperately wanted to go to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(My hand won't stop shaking...
And it feels like everyone else here is a better artist than me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Alright, just calm down...
I've been drawing literally forever...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Ever since I was really little...
Plus, until just recently, I attended that art class for sooo long...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Exam Proctor
rows.Line: It's time to start the exam.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Crap, I lost my concentration...!
Where's the exam prompt...? Here it is... We're supposed to...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sketch a glass vase using pencils...! Nice...! That's right up my alley!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Just watch! I'm gonna draw the perfect sketch...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's so unbalanced...
Once more time... I have to redraw it...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You've gotta be kidding me... Why am I having so much trouble with this? I had never had any issues when I was still going to that art class...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I still can't get it right...
What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was being delusional... I thought I was a good artist, but in reality...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, no, no...!
How's there so little time left?! I haven't made any progress at all! This isn't right!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I... I just have to clean it up and finish it...! B-But at this rate, I'm probably gonna...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No! I absolutely don't want that to happen! If I fail... If I don't get accepted...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up...!
Shut up! Shut up!! Shut up!!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Thank goodness you're not hurt...
But try not to push yourself too hard. I mean, I know art was...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay...
Also, I bought some cake, so why don't you have some once you've settled down?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What kind of daughter am I...? Taking my anger out on my own mother like that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why did things have to turn out this way...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I just wanted to draw...
I just wanted to become an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I still want to... I have to keep drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just wait... I'm gonna keep drawing and prove you wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like the more I try to draw, the more confused I get...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, I'm never gonna be able to prove him wrong... I have to make him acknowledge my talent...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, I haven't been able to draw anything since the exam...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Ugh, my head...
I can't go on...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I should lie down and rest for a bit before trying again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe it's a notification from PicShare!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if someone liked one of my old illustrations?!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, it's just recommending someone else's post...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've posted pretty much everything I've drawn, but they've gotten hardly any likes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was convinced that was because everyone on PicShare only cared about looking at the manga and the anime art that people post...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I'm really not that good...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now it's telling me about popular posts! PicShare's been sending me all these pointless notifications since that update...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A high school girl got 300 likes just for a selfie...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Geez, talk about too much editing. She went way overboard under her eyes. Honestly, I'd probably look 100 times cuter.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (See? Just hide one eye, touch it up a bit and I'll have 300 likes in no time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll put it on silent to shut it up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yikes... I just wanted to rest my eyes, but ended up sleeping for a while...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What time is it?
Where did I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What's with all these notifications...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Too cute!!>
<Super cute!>
<Your face is adorable! I wanna see more!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I wasn't expecting this kind of response...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, another notification...
Geez, how viral is this gonna get...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't be acting all satisfied...
It's just a stupid selfie...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I kinda feel like I can draw something really good now. I'll give it a go after I have breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing's changed... Or have I gotten worse...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't get the image in my head onto paper. It doesn't matter what I draw. The more I try, the worse things get...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This feels weird...
All these people are looking at my selfie...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So cute!>
<Do you not have any makeup on?! Your skin's so pretty!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, this isn't how I want to get noticed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, breaktime's over.
I'll start over and redraw it from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't understand what I'm doing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Can you post a makeup video?>
<She must be naturally this cute.>
<I envy girls with cute faces...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Alright, fine...
I'll take one of my upper body. At least I can use it as a reference for drawing human figures.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll touch up the colors a bit... Yeah, this should work...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, she's so cute!>
<Your eyelashes are so long! Jealous!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Her hair's pretty too.>
<And she's so slim.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this angle seems like the better choice. As for my light source...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm getting nowhere with my drawing, so it's okay if I do this for a little bit longer...right?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, the one I took last week has 2,000 likes...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How awesome am I?
That's way more than your run-of-the-mill idol.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe I really am that cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if this is what I'm really meant to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't what I want... I don't want likes for this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to draw something... Anything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I lose my ability to draw, then I'd really...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why am I so bad at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can't draw... I might just try to disappear.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to go somewhere that's devoid of other people...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm such an idiot...
I know full well that this kind of praise is pointless.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, I still want their likes...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <This song made me cry like a baby. I want to thank everybody who was there for me when I really needed them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, it's recommending me another post... Wait, it's just someone's opinion on a song.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This has been happening a lot.
People write all these comments hoping that other people say that they agree or that they're right...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We all want attention. We just want to be noticed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's why we write these sorts of posts, upload pics and try to get likes... To be seen...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(...?
Huh? Did I just press play...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hang on... This song...
It feels really dark, but it's having this weird effect on me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Who posted this...? K...?
Are they famous or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(My chest... It kinda hurts...
Is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, is that it...?
I'm in pain...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This song's so sad...
It's full of pain and suffering, and makes me really want to disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like it's saying, “No, don't disappear yet.”)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's right...
I don't want to disappear yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care if I lose my ability to draw... I'll keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to draw...! I want to keep drawing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm struggling to draw the way I want and don't even know what I want to draw, but...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that light piercing through the darkness...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Like I can't go anywhere right now, but I can see light at the end of the tunnel...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Or like being lost in a really dark forest where only the moon is visible... And it looks so beautiful... But it also makes you want to shout your lungs out...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't really know where I'm going with this...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I want to use this idea... I want to draw it!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, my hands are all black...
I should wash my hands later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I uploaded it...
But still no likes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I ended up falling asleep after that... I'm aching all over too. Probably because I drew for so long in such a weird posture...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I ever gonna be able to draw anything like what I did yesterday again...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I shouldn't look...
If I do, I'll get sucked back in.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...? Hold on...
That last one wasn't a like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They used my drawing to make a music video...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It wasn't a waste after all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And Mizuki was the one who sent that message.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was so happy that time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because someone had made a video out of the drawing I'd worked so hard on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
I'm glad I made it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After I discovered Kanade's music, I was able to start taking a harder look at my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I also realized then that I could keep drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After that... We agreed that you should upload that video you made, Mizuki, since you put so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While you hoped that K would see it and like it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hey, they don't need to hear that part...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry.
Anyway, I uploaded it right after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess I can take a peek at it...

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <My name is K. It's nice to make your acquaintance. I apologize if this is sudden, but I took the liberty of watching the video you posted the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <And I'd like to tell you that I enjoyed it very much.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Again, I know this is sudden, but would it be possible for you to make a music video for the next song? I can't offer much, but I'd like to compensate you for your work.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<I'll be looking forward to hearing back from you.
Sincerely, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: K wants me to make another video...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This could be the real K, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thank you for your message. This is Amia.
Thank you for watching my video. I'm happy to hear that you enjoyed it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And to be personally asked to make another music video... I'm stunned with disbelief. However...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This account... It's using the default avatar and has zero followers... I can't help but feel suspicious...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I apologize in advance, but I need to be sure of something first. Can you present me with any proof that you are actually K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've seen more than a few people who force others into producing stuff for them like this...

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'm not sure this will count as proof, but I can send over the demos of the songs I've made in the past.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
I'm being barraged with files!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if they're viruses...? No, I'm being too paranoid... Let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's that song... But a rougher version of it... Which means...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so cool...
You can totally tell it's K even though they're just demos.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's no way they'd go this far just to pull a fast one on someone like me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I never expected to be asked by K to make a video like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
K...
I wonder what they're like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What kind of personality do you need to have in order to produce songs that feels so dark and painful, but also kind and gentle...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, my curiosity being the driving factor behind me wanting to work with them probably isn't great...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I apologize for bringing your identity into question. Thank you for sending me those demos.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like to hear a little more about your proposition...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I understand.
Do you happen to have a Nightcord account, Amia...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Nightcord...?
I used it a lot back in the day when I was still playing online games.)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for us to talk on there? I believe things will proceed much smoother if we do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get to talk with K...?

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Thank you very much. Then, let's talk again later. Preferably tonight at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'd like to have the other person I work with be there as well, and they're generally only free to talk at this time...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They work as a team...?
I couldn't tell since I didn't notice any credits.)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Oh, also... I've already contacted Enanan, so we may all be able to talk to one another.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They already got a hold of Enanan...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's great.
Enanan also said they really like K's songs, so I'm sure they're over the moon about this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Understood. I have no issues with that.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Oh, good evening... This is K...
Um... Thank you for joining us today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, thank you as well.
You caught me by surprise, but I was also really happy to hear from you...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I see... I'm glad to hear that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Based on that voice... She's a girl? Pretty young too. She could be around the same age as me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A teenager? Producing the songs that she does? That's pretty incredible.)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Oh...
I think Enanan and Yuki are here now... Um, Yuki's the person I mentioned earlier who I work with.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Good evening. I apologize for running late.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, where are my manners...? Please allow me to introduce myself. My name is Yuki. I work on creating songs with K.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Actually, I just handle the arranging while K does the actual composing... It's a pleasure to meet both of you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, um... I-It's my pleasure as well...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I'm E-Enanan...
And... It's nice to meet all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Enanan... We've spoken through messages, but this is my first time actually talking to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's nice to finally meet you. I'm Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<A-Amia...?!
I didn't realize you were here!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, it's me. Thank you for giving me permission to use your art.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Of course...!
But actually getting to talk like this feels so strange...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Anyway, I'll set that aside for now...
There's something I'd like to ask you, K...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <A-Are you really sure about using my art for this...?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's just... Yes, I was beyond ecstatic when you contacted me about this...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I took a step back and thought that someone else's art would be more suitable...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh...
She's such an amazing artist, but doesn't have much confidence in herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(How's K gonna respond...?
Just trying to comfort her probably isn't the right answer...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <At the very least, I genuinely thought that.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I agree with K on this one...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You could feel this torrent of powerful emotions... And so much sadness... It's clear that you put quite a lot of thought into your piece as you drew it...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <So, I first saw the music video that you two worked on the night before last...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And I was struck by how you'd managed to carefully capture everything we hoping to express through this song.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<On top of that...
I could feel and understand that powerful urge to shout out loud.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's the same thing I felt when I saw her illustration...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like she was shouting, “I can keep going,” or, “I want to keep walking”...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I made my video with that in mind, as well as a few of my feelings sprinkled in...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's really incredible...
We all felt the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Thanks to the video that you two made, Amia, Enanan, our songs have been receiving more views and comments.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <It seems like more people have been listening to our songs than ever before, so we greatly appreciate what you've done.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Um, well... That's because your song was so good, but...!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But... I'm really glad that my skills could be of service.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'd also like to have the songs we make heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And I believe that we'll be able to do that if you keep making music videos for us, Enanan, Amia. That's why I decided to ask you to help us...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Does that mean she wants to go pro or something...? For a moment there, she got a little intense...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And this is the demo for our next song...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It's still a bit rough, but please listen to it if you like.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Wait, are you sure?
This song hasn't been released yet, right?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's right.
We'd like you to make the music video for it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of song it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This song... It's completely different from the other ones! It's so scary and jarring...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But there's still that bit of kindness...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her other songs included, K's music always seems to include that kind and gentle feeling somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's almost like she's trying to reach out to me with her hand...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <As far as design requirements go, I have none. I won't mind what you make as long as you find a way to express what you feel after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, we're free to do what we like...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She trusts us this much after just seeing one music video we made...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm still having trouble understanding what she's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<How do you feel about this, Amia...?
It sounded like you were still undecided.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Y-Yes...
I thought I should hear more details before coming to a decision.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After hearing your explanation, as well as this demo, I've decided that I want to do this...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<This is wonderful news, K.
And thank you, Amia. We look forward to working with you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to working with you as well, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(There's still a lot that I don't know...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Right now...
I know for sure that I want to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In terms of a workflow, I was thinking that I'd take your illustrations, Enanan, and turn them into a video. How does that sound?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Then, let's go with that.
Oh, however, I won't have much to do while I wait for you to complete your illustrations, so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Would it be alright if I asked you to draw me a rough draft first? It should help me figure out what kind of video I want to make.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Like some sketches?
Yes, I can do that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but we can always work together if you ever need any help! It's nice to sort of have free reign, but I'm the sort of person that needs some structure.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I really appreciate it.
Fortunately, I have a good idea of what I want to draw, so I should be able to get a rough draft to you in fairly short order.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let me know once it's finished. In the meantime, I'll listen to that song again and try coming up with some ideas.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Okay, I'll do that!
For now, I'll be muting myself while I work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Okay...
That clears up how we're actually gonna work together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(This feels kinda strange...
I'm so used to making videos by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I should brainstorm while I wait for her to send me that rough draft...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This pain and suffering... You get such a clear picture... It's like K and Yuki have actually been to the depths of despair...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's like when you're unable to talk because you're in so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This mix of turbulence and silence really sticks out in my mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do I turn that into a video...? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Already...?
Oh, I need to unmute myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That was fast.
I wasn't expecting you to have it ready so soon.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I think I have K's song to thank for that. I usually end up hitting a wall and have a hard time coming up with ideas... Oh, I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What did she draw this time...?
I can't help but have high hopes since her last illustration was so good.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's a drawing of a girl screaming...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So this is her interpretation...
It's pretty different from what I had in mind...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But I really like it...
You can tell exactly what she's saying.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<How is it...?
Is there anything that concerns you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, not at all!
I think it's a really great drawing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'd like to take what you drew and start thinking about how to turn it into a video, so you can keep working on what you have.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I can throw in a wipe here for the first verse and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it doesn't really go well with the second verse... How do I deal with that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Maybe some different effects?
That might change the feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I could try an effect where the screaming girl gets filled in black...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that won't work...
On one hand, I can try out some different things, but on the other, that might make it harder for me to tie this part into the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why don't I feel as motivated as last time? Before, I was able to charge on ahead without even thinking about getting permission to use someone else's art...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Maybe I should ask Enanan...
But she's probably hard at work drawing right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Everything I believed, felt and wanted to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm here. Can I help you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's just... I noticed that you paused for a moment when you took your first glance at it.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<And I began to wonder...
Is something about my drawing bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's sort of easy for me to tell because I've been drawing since I was little. Based on your reaction, you seemed...confused...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Initially, I thought I was overreacting...
But I gave it some time and realized that I probably wasn't...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I was... Um...
I wasn't confused per se...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I really don't know anything about art...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<That's perfectly fine.
I just want to hear about what you felt when you saw my drawing, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I mean, if something about it really is bothering you, can't you just tell me?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yes, I really hate it when someone says that my art's garbage...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I hate it even more when people treat me with kid gloves and tip-toe around everything!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If she's willing to say that, then I should probably just honestly tell her what I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Although, there's no guarantee that she'll understand my interpretation of this song...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Every so often, I'd meet people who understand the pain I feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But something seemed odd about how this girl's screaming.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, when I listened to this song...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I felt this terrible pain. The kind of pain that keeps you even from screaming...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <The kind of pain that keeps you from screaming...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, instead of having a girl shouting, I think it might be better to make it look like she's trying to smile even though she really isn't in the mood to...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I'm not sure I get what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, let's forget what I just said.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Why did you feel that way, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I mean, when you feel emotional pain, you suffer physically too, right...?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <This absolute unbearable amount of pain that you feel and want to do something about... But you can't, so you have no other choice but to scream.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <That was my interpretation of why this song felt so turbulent.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I definitely understand what you mean by that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Because there was a time when I also felt that pain...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Each time someone hurt me, I'd always ask myself, “Why me?” I was shouting that within my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I have a feeling that Enanan bears some similar scars...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I believe it's possible to be stricken with so much pain that you can't even scream.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After feeling an incredible amount of pain for a really long time, there comes a point where you stop caring about anything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you try to do something fun to forget about that pain... But it doesn't go away...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How would anyone have the energy to scream at that point...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh...
I might've taken that a little too far...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Doing something fun to forget about that pain, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I-I'm sorry...
That was all just my opinion...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I think I know what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But let me ask you this. How did you interpret this really turbulent melody? I thought it was about wanting to scream or shout out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, um...
I saw that as a violent storm raging inside your heart.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Even though there's something you want to scream, you don't because you feel that no one will get it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And yet, it lingers and persists...
Because it's what you truly feel.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<...
I see. I never would've seen it that way...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I think I understand what you saw now... I would've drawn something fairly different if I had earlier...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, even though Enanan and I didn't interpret this song the same way, I understood her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Still... What is this I'm feeling...?
Enanan and I felt different things, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We both arrived at different interpretations, but neither is necessarily right or wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We led different lives until this point, so it's only natural for us to interpret the songs K makes with that person in different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time... I get the feeling that Enanan went through a really tough time like I did...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if we tried to express what we both felt? You know, together...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, um... I can make this music video by using your art to show what's happening during the song while animating the lyrics and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm guessing that we both felt a complex mix of emotions after listening to K's song, and even discovered some new feelings...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It's hard for me to describe...
But I have a feeling that the music video isn't gonna turn out very well unless we get on the same page.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <By putting our heads together and talking things out like this, we should be able to come up with some good ideas.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree...
For K's sake, we've gotta make this video a good one...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I just realized that I stopped being formal there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Oh, me too...
Actually, this might be easier, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, are we good in terms of our theme?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<A silent scream, right...?
Yeah, I think I can work with that.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I'm gonna have to change her expression and everything since she's just letting everything out into the open right now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... I hate to ask you this, but would you mind drawing it again?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Also, you don't have to feel bad...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <There's nothing wrong with asking for a redo if it means the final product is gonna look better, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, there's something else that we should talk about before you get back to drawing...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How we're actually going to present the pain this girl's feeling as she screams in silence.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Of course, we can use your first sketch for that, Enanan... But videos allow you to animate things, so I was thinking that we could give her more of a backstory...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah, that does sound like a good idea...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <When we were discussing our interpretations just now, Amia, I realized that you probably weren't feeling the same things as me...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I'm also starting to think that our feelings share the same root. Like something we each care about is being rejected by others...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So, if we can represent that visually, then I feel like the end result will make a lot more sense. In terms of motifs...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I know...!
What if we made it so this girl's holding a box?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah. It'll represent what she cares about most.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <While others will try to take it away from her, smash it to pieces or call it worthless.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see...!
And the viewer gets to decide what's inside!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's an awesome idea!
And people who've experienced the same sort of rejection will immediately understand... Oh, wait...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, um... Just a small suggestion... Can we give this box a nice ribbon with a bow?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. This box is supposed to be extremely precious to her, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And wouldn't a ribbon make it a little cuter...?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Alright, so... I'll draw another sketch... But do you think we should discuss beforehand how the animation's gonna look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I can try coming up with a storyboard based on your sketch, and you can complete your illustration after that...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Right...
Then, let's give that a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks.
I'm looking forward to seeing your next sketch.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If our music video is gonna do the pain and kindness from K's song justice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Hm...? The door to Mizuki's room is open...

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I wasn't expecting to see anything like this...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I think it's incredible...
The last one was also good, but this one really blew me away.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, Enanan, you deserve the credit!
Thanks for doing all those redraws!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
You two seem so close now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, um... That sort of just happened on its own as we worked...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, is there anything you'd like for us to fix? It shouldn't be too hard to adjust the coloring and such...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<No, that's okay.
This music video... It's a clear expression of everything that you both felt after hearing our song...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Right...
So, there's actually something else that I'd like to discuss with you...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Would you like to keep making these with us?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Wait, us...?
As in the four of us as a group...?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Yes.
I arrived at this decision after seeing this video.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <You both seem to understand how to express what we're feeling in a way that other people would struggle to.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I believe that more people will listen to our songs if you two keep making music videos for them.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <By doing so, I might be able to save someone...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <In order to actually have more people listen, I need your artistic talents, Enanan, as well as your video editing skills, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I promise to draw incredible illustrations for you...!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<I'm happy to hear that as well...!
We'll be looking forward to working with you more, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I understand...
Once you've made your decision, please let me know whenever.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I still stand by my belief that I want to do what I can to have our songs heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <However, I also personally want to see you make more videos...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Because what you make, Amia...
There's so much pain, but also kindness.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I still stand by my belief that I want to do what I can to have our songs heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <However, I also personally want to see you make more videos...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Because what you make, Amia...
There's so much pain, but also kindness.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's incredible how she can just say stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I have all the time in the world since I'm not really going to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, it was really fun to make something with other people while chatting with them about stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Being called weird and treated like an outcast... Being torn away from someone I really liked hanging out with...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line:
Mizuki...?
Is now a good time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'm actually having some trouble getting my suitcase to close and was hoping you could help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It won't close...? But you're leaving tomorrow. Are you sure you're gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'll manage somehow...
Also, there's a couple of things that I want to give you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This video. Is it the one you were working on for that anime? MiraMagi, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's for something else.
I made it for some people I met online...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, one thing led to another and they ended up asking me to make a video for them. I was given a song demo for reference and worked on it with this artist girl.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was my first time working with another person, so there were some growing pains... But because I did, I think I was able to produce a really good one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why you seemed to be having so much fun lately, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess it was.
I got a chance to really talk about what I was thinking and feeling, and they understood. Which led to a great result...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I should be there with them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know why I feel that way, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Mizuki...
I don't think there's such a thing as a place where you shouldn't be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You're free to go wherever you wish and stay wherever you like. Conversely, you don't have to go anywhere if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, Mizuki, what do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'll be happy as long as you believe in what you believe, Mizuki. I always have and always will.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Don't mind what anybody else thinks, Mizuki. Your feelings come first. That's why I asked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This may sound a bit strange or even rude, but I'm actually really glad to see right now that you're so concerned.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because, until just recently, I thought you'd given up on everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Like when you stopped wearing that ribbon you like so much. It was as if nothing mattered to you anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But that doesn't seem to be the case now. You're showing genuine concern for something that you don't want to lose.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And that makes me incredibly happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's perfectly okay for you to do what you want, Mizuki, because I'm absolutely sure that you'll find others who understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I mean, you're just the cutest!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, you should go where you want to go... And be where you want to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Until this point, no one seemed to understand what you thought was most important or cared about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You've endured so much already, so I get why you're scared...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I should return to packing.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I wanted to give you this mannequin.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's too big for me to take, so I was hoping that you could put it in your room!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That way, if you ever feel the desire, you could start making clothes again like you used to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes. I made it using my favorite kind of fabric. It's cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, if you ever feel like wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: There's no need to abandon the things that you truly love.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever told you this before, but I also thought about abandoning my dream several times.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Luckily, I had you. The look of joy on your face as you wore the clothes and ribbons I'd made prevented me from doing so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: People may end up saying some really awful things about you. But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Please...
Don't ever forget that I'll always be on your side, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Whatever you choose to do in life, I'll be there to support you every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Whatever I choose to do in life...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm honestly still pretty scared... But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This might actually not end up going well.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I might end up back in a place where nothing matters to me anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For this, I should do absolutely everything I can before even thinking about giving up.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Good evening...
Sorry for the late response.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia... I'm glad that you're back.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like it if we could keep working together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After giving this a lot of thought...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I think this is also my first time hearing about your big sister being the one who gave you that push.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I still don't understand why you were so concerned about joining...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Chalk it up to coming of age, I guess♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I forgot to tell you back then... So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For your very first video. If you hadn't used my illustration, we might not be here talking like this right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Ena, that's like ancient history now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Kanade! Mafuyu!
You two hardly ever come here at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I found some time to work...
Also, Kanade wanted to hear what I thought about her new demo.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
We even sent messages to both of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
We were having so much fun talking that we didn't notice at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you already made another one?
I still can't believe how fast you work, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really...?
More importantly, what were you all doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The past!
We were just talking about how Ena and I joined N25!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It was nice to learn more about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
When you two first joined... That's very nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember feeling so nervous that time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you were?
You sounded really mature from my point of view.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
R-Really?
I was just trying to be as honest as I could...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why you were so direct with your comments. I guess that's just the way you are, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on. Do you actually remember?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Probably? What's that supposed to mean? Also, you said you liked my illustration that time. Don't tell me you didn't actually mean it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...!
Yeah, Ena! What they said!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Talk about a huge blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked about so much too. The good and the bad... But now, I...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hello? Sis?
Thanks for sending me that package!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The new clothes you made were so cute!
I also wore the ribbon you sent right away!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I shared the snacks you sent with everyone from my group. They really enjoyed them, so thanks a bunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
How have I been lately?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
Alright, let's get down to... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a file.
Ena's already done. That was fast.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! She copied me and paid homage to our first music video!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is really awesome!
And it's gonna look amazing after I throw in a few effects!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... Let's get down to business!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We're gonna get a ton of people to listen to Kanade and Mafuyu's song through our video.)
